summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Iter60 Frasberg Creator import. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter60_frasberg_creator.py — covers creator root, shared platform auth on /api/creator/auth/me (401 unauth / 200 authed), separate creator register+login removed (404/405), authenticated generations/voice-takes/spaces CRUD, public showcase + chat/models + gpu/v1/engines, admin RBAC on /api/creator/engines/status & /gpu-admin/overview (403 for user, 200 for admin), and platform regression (/api/auth/me, /api/keys, image-generation permission matrix: video-only key -> 403, image key empty prompt -> 400). Frontend: /create renders Frasberg Creator shell with all 7 tabs (create, tools, models, templates, engines, features, capabilities); each creator-view-{tab} loads without crash; /studio also renders Frasberg Creator; /create/classic renders Classic Studio; all 9 Tools subroutes (/creator/video, tts, sts, voice-clone, audio, 3d, spaces, gallery, agent) load inside the Creator shell without blank screen; Image template click navigates to /create?tab=create&prompt=... and the Generator textarea is correctly prefilled (153 chars). Spaces: 'New space' button creates and opens editor at /creator/spaces/new. Navbar.jsx uses label 'Frasberg Creator' (no stale 'Creative Studio' anywhere in /app/frontend/src outside creator mock copy).

issues: 'New space' button wraps to two lines inside the pill — consider whitespace-nowrap

critical_code_review_comments: CreatorRoutes.jsx hard-codes active='tools' for every subroute, including /creator/gallery and /creator/agent which also appear as explicit cards — fine but means the header always highlights Tools even when the user is deep inside e.g. SpaceEditor; consider deriving active from the route.

Many /creator/* subpages trigger 403 console errors on load (gated endpoints hit without the right permissions). Pages render fine but noisy; worth filtering 403 fetches or gating the client calls on role.
